## Background

You work as a data scientist for a clinic that received a grant to study the potential for testosterone replacement therapy to raise cortisol levels. Practitioners are concerned that a commonly used treatment could increase serum cortisol, a stress related hormone. High levels of cortisol (above 25 mcg/dL) have been shown to be associated with weight gain, insomnia, and high blood pressure.

The clinic has run a randomized study in which people were assigned to one of two conditions, a placebo condition and a drug condition. After two weeks of treatment, participants returned to the clinic and a fasting blood sample was taken in the morning. The blood sample was used to measure the levels of cortisol for each participant. **Your primary objective is to test if participants who received the drug treatment have higher levels of serum cortisol in comparison to the placebo condition.**
